newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan OKs United Micro, GVC convertibles.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan OKs United Micro, GVC convertibles.

text.p: Taiwan's Securities and Exchange Commission said on Friday it had given the approval for chipmaker United Microelectronics to issue US$250-$300 million convertible bonds overseas.
The SEC also approved the issue of US$150 million in convertible bonds by computer modem and motherboard maker GVC Corp, it said in a statement.

The statement did not say whether the GVC convertible bonds will be issued in Taiwan or abroad, but when the size of the issue is given U.S. dollars and not in Taiwan dollars, this indicates it is to be issued abroad.
An SEC official said by telephone the funds raised by United Microelectronics will be used to purchase raw materials and for expansion.
A GVC official told Reuters the convertibles will be issued abroad later in May and the funds raised will be used to purchase raw materials.
